main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move of long cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 on at least 30 case-days; reject: t <= -2 on at least 30 case-days

supporting_check.name: larger-half minus smaller-half mean unusual move (by forecast)

decided_by: Mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 on at least 30 case-days, and the larger-half minus smaller-half difference above 0.
reading: A case is the first bar in each 5-bar grid cell (from each window's first row) where the long forecast rises by at least 2 points from its lowest level since the last bet, its 5-bar return needing the bar 5 rows later in the same window; the day-clustered t uses per-day summed deviations with a G/(G-1) correction; the halves are the lower and upper floor(n/2) cases by forecast rank (ties by time, coin), the middle case left out when n is odd.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01427 on the check folds against +0.01747 on every fold
